dashboardNothingExpiring: Nothing expires in the next 30 days
brandDomainsHint: One domain=userId per line. The login page of that domain shows the brand of that manager.
brandAdminHint: Default appearance of the whole platform. Managers can override it for their users.
brandManagerHint: Your users and all users below you see this appearance.
brandLogoTooLarge: The image must be smaller than 200 KB
dashcamPhotoRequested: Photo requested, it appears here when the camera sends it

dashcamNoEvents: No camera events in this period
mapRulerHint: Click on the map to measure
dashcamChannelsHelp: Cameras connected: dashcams usually 1-3, MDVR up to 12

dashcamProtocolHelp: Defines which commands are sent for photos and live video
dashcamCommandHelp: {camera} = OUT (channel 1), IN (channel 2) or INOUT. Check your firmware command list
addDeviceBulkList: Units, one per line: IMEI, name
addDeviceBulkHelp: Same model, group, users and icon for all

statusUnknownHelp: Devices sending data with an IMEI that is not registered. Add them in one click.
unitInfoEmpty: No vehicle data or sensors yet: add them in Edit → Unit information / Sensors.
sensorSourceHelp: Value sent by the device, e.g. io201 (LLS), adc1, fuel, temp1
sensorsSaveHint: Sensor changes apply when the unit is saved.
sensorCalibrationHelp: Device value → real value (e.g. litres), interpolated between points.
sensorWaitTimeHelp: The change must hold this long to count
sensorFilterHelp: Median of N readings against sloshing
sensorStoppedOnly: Detect only while stopped (never in motion)
sensorNoData: The unit has not sent this parameter yet.
fuelNoSensor: This unit has no fuel sensor. Add one in Edit → Sensors.
fuelNoEvents: No fills or drains in this period.
fuelSettingsHint: Detected while stopped: fill ≥ {fill}, drain ≥ {drain}, confirmed after {wait} s.
fuelReportSubtitle: Detailed analysis of fuel consumption and events
fuelChooseDevice: Choose a unit to see its fuel report.
fuelPercentHelp: Set the tank capacity in the sensor to see percentages
fuelFeatureAnomaliesText: Suspicious drains, detected only while stopped.
fuelFeatureExportText: Download to Excel or print to PDF with all details.
fuelFeatureMapText: Every event on the map at its exact location.
fuelFeatureAlertsText: Get fill and drain alerts by web, email or Telegram.
engineCutPendingSince: Cut pending since {time}: it will be sent when the unit stops.
engineCutMovingHelp: The unit is too fast to stop the engine safely. You can schedule the cut for when it stops.
engineCutWarning: The engine will stop and cannot start again until resumed. Who ordered it is logged.
engineCutConfirm: I confirm I want to stop this unit's engine
engineResumeConfirm: I confirm I want to resume the engine
engineCutMoving: The unit is moving: the cut was not sent.
engineCutPendingSet: Cut scheduled: it will be sent as soon as the unit stops.
trackExpired: This tracking link expired or is not valid.
trackDestinationHelp: Paste the coordinates from Google Maps to show the estimated arrival
trackLinkHelp: Simple page with the unit, destination and estimated arrival
evidenceNotFound: The drain was not found in this period.
evidenceNoMedia: No camera photos in this interval.
evidenceDisclaimer: Data recorded by the unit GPS device and fuel probe; the amount is computed with the tank calibration set on the platform.
drivingSubtitle: Harsh braking, acceleration, cornering and speeding per unit and driver
drivingHint: Select a period to compute the score
drivingNoDrivers: No identified drivers in the period
drivingMethod: 100 points minus penalties per incident per 100 km (minimum 10 km). Harsh events come from GPS and device alarms.
expensesSubtitle: Fuel, tolls, workshop and other costs per unit
expenseNoMaintenance: No maintenance configured for these units
playbackHint: Pick a day and search the recordings stored on the device card/disk.
playbackOffline: The device is not connected. Recordings can only be queried while online.
playbackTimeout: The device did not respond in time. Try again.
playbackTimeoutJimi: The camera did not send its recording list. Check that FILELIST points to the server (see the installation guide) and that it is online.
playbackDownloadMinute: Download this minute to the gallery
playbackDownloadRequested: Video requested: it will appear in Camera events once the camera uploads it (it may take a few minutes).
retentionCompact: Compacts after {days} days (1 point every {seconds} s while moving)
retentionMediaCompress: Compresses photos and videos after {days} days
retentionMediaMax: Media up to {size} GB (overwrites the oldest)
retentionNever: Not run yet. It runs daily at the set hour or with "Run now".
videoPhotoRequested: Photo requested: it will arrive in Cameras › Events
videoHint: Drag the bar to move, the corner to resize; double-click to maximize
alertCenterSubtitle: Everything that needs attention, by priority, with follow-up and response times
fleetMaintenanceSubtitle: Status of every plan per unit, services done and what comes next
maintenanceNoPlans: These units have no maintenance plans. Create them and assign them to units or groups.
maintenanceNothingSoon: Nothing due in the next 90 days
maintenanceRestartsHint: Registering the service restarts the plan from this odometer or date
qualitySubtitle: How well each device reports: gaps, GPS, signal, power and reconnections
qualityGapSilent: Silent for hours (off or no signal)
qualityGapWorking: Lost with the engine on / moving
qualityAdviceNoData: no positions in the period; check installation, data plan and server address.
qualityAdviceOffline: silent for more than a day; it may be unplugged, out of battery or out of coverage.
qualityAdviceGaps: reports lost while working; check carrier coverage, GSM antenna or reporting interval.
qualityAdviceInvalidFix: many positions without a valid fix; check the GPS antenna placement (sky view, not under metal).
qualityAdviceWeakGps: few satellites or high HDOP; the GPS antenna may be badly placed or damaged.
qualityAdviceWeakSignal: low GSM signal; consider another carrier, a multi-network SIM or moving the device.
qualityAdviceLowPower: low voltage or power cut alarms; check the battery connection and fuse.
qualityAdviceReconnects: reconnects many times a day; usually unstable signal or a loose power contact.
qualityAdviceClock: sends future timestamps; set the device timezone (decoder.timezone) or GPS time sync.
reportBuilderSubtitle: Build your report: data, columns, filters, grouping and totals; save it as a template
reportBuilderHint: Choose the data source, columns and period, then press Show.
reportBuilderInvalid: The template could not be read
reportBuilderNoTemplates: Save your reports to reuse them in one click
reportPeriodTooLong: The maximum period for this source is {days} days
qualityAdviceFewReports: sends very few positions; check the reporting interval set in the device (moving and stopped).
serviceManyUnitsHint: One service is created per unit; leave the last service empty to use each unit's current reading
serviceNextDateHint: You can type the expiry date directly
serviceNoticeHint: Km, hours or days left when the reminder is generated. It must be smaller than the service interval.
serviceRenewOn: When due it notifies and the cycle starts again automatically (greasing, routine tasks).
serviceRenewOff: When due it stays overdue until the service or renewal is registered.
serviceEmailsHint: They get the reminder by e-mail even if they are not platform users (comma separated)
serviceAlertExists: You already have a maintenance alert; the chosen channels are added if missing.
serviceAlertCreate: A "Maintenance required" alert is created for all your units with the chosen channels.
chatEmpty: No messages yet. Write to the driver on WhatsApp.
chatNoPhone: The driver has no WhatsApp number: add it as the driver's "phone" attribute or the unit's "driverPhone".
chatNotConfigured: WhatsApp is not configured on the server: messages will not be delivered.
chatQuickStop: Stop the vehicle in a safe place
panelNearestHint: Estimated road distance (×1.3) at 35 km/h average.
panelNoAlerts: No open alerts with these priorities 🎉
panelNoCameras: No unit has a camera configured.
panelNoFuelChanges: No fills or drains in the last 12 h.
panelNoFuelUnits: No unit has a fuel sensor
panelNoWorkspaces: Save the open panels to restore them later.
panelPickPointHint: Click on the map where the job or incident is.
panelRouteHint: draw the route with clicks and choose the unit to compare
panelSaveHint: they are saved with their position and size.
panelCommandQueued: Queued: sent when the unit connects
ruleChannelsHelp: Sent to the alert owner; you can also add e-mails and WhatsApp numbers.
ruleCommandHelp: Sent to the unit when the alert fires.
ruleCommandSafeCut: Safe cut: if the unit is moving, the cut waits until it stops.
ruleCooldownHelp: Do not repeat before this time
ruleEmpty: You have no custom alerts yet.
ruleEventsHelp: Choose the device events that fire the alert.
ruleExtraHelp: All must hold at once (e.g. door open AND speed > 5 km/h).
ruleMinDurationHelp: The condition must hold this long
ruleNoHistory: No alerts in the last 7 days.
ruleParameterHelp: Any value the device sends (io201, adc1, temp1…)
ruleSubtitle: Conditions on sensors, parameters, speed, geofences, times and events, with schedule, duration, actions and own message
ruleTestEvents: Event alerts fire with the device event.
ruleUseGeofenceLimit: Use the limit of the current geofence
ruleHelpGps: No valid fix or fewer than 3 satellites
ruleTypeHelpSensor: Temperature, weight, RPM… in or out of range
ruleTplSpeedHelp: Over 90 km/h for 30 s, 10 min pause
ruleTplDoorHelp: Door sensor on and speed > 5 km/h
ruleTplColdChainHelp: Temperature out of range for 5 min
ruleTplSosHelp: Panic button or crash, no pause
sensorAccumulateHelp: Relative mileage, impulses, counters, relative hours
sensorBoundsHelp: Values outside the bounds are discarded
sensorExpressionHelp: Parameters, #sensor, bits (in1:3), + − * / ^, comparisons, && ||, abs round min max if bit
sensorRangesHelp: Colors the value in the card and panel (e.g. blue < 2 °C, green 2–8, red > 8)
sensorThresholdHelp: On when the value is at or above (RPM, voltage)
sensorValidatorHelp: E.g. fuel valid only with ignition on
sensorReportSubtitle: Minimum, average, maximum, period totals, time on and time in each color range of every sensor
customAlertsReportSubtitle: Alerts raised by your rules: by rule, unit, priority, day and hour, with their handling status
geofenceSpeedUse: Use a speed limit in this geofence

geofenceSpeedAlertReady: Speeding arrives as a web alert and in the alert center (mild = medium, dangerous = high, critical = critical).
geofenceSpeedReportSubtitle: Seriousness of each excess by the km/h above the geofence limit: mild, dangerous or critical

geofenceRankingHelp: Score: mild 1, dangerous 3, critical 5 per excess
geofenceDrawCircle: Draw circle (click the center and click again for the radius)
geofenceCoordinatesHelp: Paste the coordinates (e.g. from Google Maps) or pick the point on the map

planNotAssignable: Includes modules your plan does not have
planBasicOnly: Basic features only (map, history, geofences, standard alerts and reports)
